title: Maximum Billboard Foundation
description: You are hired to build a large digital billboard in a city plaza. The plaza is paved with vertical stone pillars of varying heights, all having a width of 1 unit. You need to find the area of the largest rectangular billboard that can fit continuously across these stone pillars without hanging over empty space.
input_format: An array of non-negative integers representing the heights of the stone pillars.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum possible rectangular area.

examples.explanation: The largest rectangle is formed by pillars of height 5 and 6, giving an area of 2 * 5 = 10.
The largest rectangle has height 2 spanning both pillars, or height 4 on the second pillar. Max area is 4.
The largest rectangle spans from index 4 to 6 with height 5 or 4, yielding optimal area.
